faqs.a: Websites and online shops, AI assistants (chatbots) for enquiries and bookings, automation of repetitive work, custom apps, maintenance of existing sites, and consulting and training on AI tools. I work with small businesses, associations and public bodies.
It depends on the scope, so I don't quote prices off the cuff. After a short call you get a written quote with a fixed price and deadline, with no hidden items. The first call is free.
A small website is usually done in two to four weeks, and an AI assistant or a single automation is often quicker. Larger projects are built in phases. The exact deadline is always in the quote.

faqs.q: Do you work with public bodies?
faqs.a: Yes. I respond to requests for quotes and tenders in the Croatian e-procurement system (EOJN RH), issue e-invoices, and hand over source code and documentation. Websites are built to WCAG 2.1 AA in line with Croatian web accessibility law. Send requests to marko@mangai.hr.

A program on your website, WhatsApp or email that answers common questions from your own information, takes enquiries and bookings, and sends you a summary. When it doesn't know the answer, it hands the conversation to you. You can try examples in the Examples section.
I use EU hosting and services wherever possible, and when a system handles personal data we sign a GDPR data processing agreement. You remain the owner of your data.
Marko Škorić, the owner of MangAI. No middlemen and no subcontractors without your knowledge. I use AI tools to work faster, but everything is reviewed before handover.
The business is registered in Ploče, Croatia. Most work is done remotely, and I meet in person by arrangement, anywhere in Croatia.

messages: I'd suggest a fast, mobile-friendly site with a clear call to action and an enquiry or booking form. Basic SEO, a link to your Google profile and a short editing tutorial are included. A small site is usually done in two to four weeks.

I'd suggest an AI assistant on your site or WhatsApp that answers common questions, takes enquiries and bookings, and sends you a summary. Fewer missed calls, and you step in only when needed. You can try it in the Examples section.

I'd suggest starting with the one task that takes most of your time, such as copying enquiries into a sheet, client reminders or weekly reports, and automating it. Once that works, we move to the next.
For a custom app we first write a short specification: who uses it, what it must do and which systems it connects to. Based on that, you get a quote with a fixed price and deadline.
I take over maintenance of existing sites: updates, backups, hosting and small changes. I start by reviewing the site and telling you what needs fixing.
